items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 16 at 9:34AM EDT by NWS State College PA
items.description:
At 934 AM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from 8 miles northeast of Scandia to 7 miles
southwest of Chapman State Park, moving east at 60 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Warren, Bradford, Kane, Sheffield, Wetmore, Russell, James City,
Ludlow, Kinzua Dam, Westline, Scandia, Marshburg, Warren South,
Chapman State Park, Cyclone, Mount Jewett, Lewis Run, Starbrick,
Clarendon and University Of Pittsburgh - Bradford.
items.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a building.

This storm may intensify, so be certain to monitor local radio
stations and available television stations for additional information
and possible warnings from the National Weather Service.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 16 at 8:26AM EDT until October 16 at 4:00PM EDT by NWS Burlington VT
items.areaDesc: Eastern Clinton; Grand Isle; Western Franklin; Western Chittenden
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...In New York, Eastern Clinton County. In Vermont, Grand
Isle, Western Chittenden, and Western Franklin Counties.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM EDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest gusts will be on southeast
facing shorelines and across Lake Champlain.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
